Code read (needs the live bank for an end-to-end build): data/nta_blueprints/english.json order.layout 'sets_first_then_mixed_verbal': two passage sets of 4-5 questions at Q1-5 and Q6-10, then standalone verbal-ability types from Q11-50, max same-type run 3, 'more than 3 passages is not authentic'. Question 15 is therefore a vocabulary or grammar item. nta_engine.js layout() and the contiguity checks enforce it; the paper is not started without two complete sets.

Code read (the live bank is out of reach here). nta_engine.js: NTA_TIME_BUDGET_MS = 30_000 with a deadline checked in fill, repair and runLevel; NTA_MIN_SCORE 8 plus a fit-score gate; selection by creation day newest first (NTA_RECENCY_BUCKET_MS), then score; blueprints exist for every public subject in nta_blueprints/index.json (english, general_test, accountancy, business_studies, economics, mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, history, political_science, geography, psychology, sociology, computer_science). src/lib/server/ntaPaper.js and the engine import no model client, so there is no per-mock AI call. Ran data/tests/nta_engine.test.mjs and nta_blueprints.test.mjs: all pass except the 2,000-question timing test, which took 4.4 s on this loaded PC (it asserts a tighter bound than 30 s).

data/exam_integrity.mjs and ExamIntegrityGuard.jsx: 3 strikes (INTEGRITY_STRIKES = 3), the third submits (onTerminate to submitTest('nta_strikes')); a tab switch (visibilitychange hidden) counts immediately; fullscreen exit counts immediately; a window blur counts after a 150 ms debounce. There is no 3 s rule: an interruption of 200 ms to 2.9 s (a notification stealing focus) counts as a warning. No grace period beyond the 150 ms debounce, which matches 'no grace'. The monitor's 'away' flag stops double counting while away.
results.fix: In onBlur use a 3000 ms timer that is cancelled by focus, and count visibilitychange-hidden immediately only when it lasts longer than the OS notification case (or count hidden immediately and blur after 3 s). Add a test that a 2 s blur adds no strike and a 4 s blur adds one.
